name.en: Inspecting the body to find problems

summary.zh: 先找出哪里出问题，才能用对处理方法。
summary.en: Find what is wrong before choosing treatment.

rules.zh: 系统先给出疼痛或异常提示，玩家打开身体视图逐部位检查，再选择相应工具处理。信息不是一次全部弹出；发现的位置和外观决定下一步操作。
rules.en: A warning signals pain or trouble. Open a body view, inspect regions and choose tools for the issue found. Location and appearance guide action instead of one all-purpose heal button.

loop.en: Identify the issue and choose a tool

decisions.zh: 先快速检查最可能的部位，还是全面排查？
decisions.en: Inspect the likeliest region first or check everything?

decisions.zh: 看到表面伤口后还要不要查找其他问题？
decisions.en: After finding one wound, should you keep checking?

effect.zh: 提示越模糊越强调观察，但必须有可辨认的外观或部位线索。
effect.en: Vague warnings emphasize observation but need legible visual or location clues.

effect.zh: 检查占用时间会带来时机取舍；免费检查更适合慢节奏诊断。
effect.en: Timed inspection creates urgency; free inspection supports slower diagnosis.

implementation.zh: 玩家旋转查看四肢，发现水蛭或伤口，并把处理物品拖到对应位置。
implementation.en: Players rotate and inspect limbs for leeches or wounds, then apply items to the affected location.

observation.zh: 系统参考图：角色伸出带伤的手臂供检查；这张图没有展示完整治疗过程。
observation.en: System reference: The character holds out a wounded arm for inspection; the full treatment process is not shown. See the linked text source for the rules.

implementation.zh: 健康面板把身体分为多个部位，显示各部位伤势并提供处理操作；相比三维观察更偏列表诊断。
implementation.en: The health panel separates body regions, lists their injuries and offers treatment actions; diagnosis is more list-based than 3D inspection.

observation.zh: 系统参考图：角色、僵尸与屏幕边缘的状态图标可见；身体健康面板没有打开。
observation.en: System reference: The character, zombies and status icons are visible; the body-health panel is not open. See the linked text source for the rules.

contrast.zh: 绿色地狱让玩家亲眼寻找局部异常；僵尸毁灭工程把定位信息集中到部位列表，读信息的成本更低。
contrast.en: Green Hell makes players visually find issues; Project Zomboid centralizes locations in a readable body-part list.

combination.zh: 设计提案：用伤口位置和环境线索推断刚才触发了什么危险，并为下一次路线选择提供依据。
combination.en: Design proposal: combine wound location with scene clues to infer the hazard and revise the next route.

setup.zh: 演示设定：行走后出现异常提示，但没有说明原因。
setup.en: Example: a warning appears after walking without stating its cause.

action.zh: 检查左腿，发现附着的小虫。
action.en: Inspect the left leg and find a parasite.

result.zh: 移除后警告消失，状态停止恶化。
result.en: Removing it clears the warning and stops deterioration.

next.zh: 记住这片水域，下次穿越后主动检查。
next.en: Remember the water crossing and inspect after using it again.

firstStep.zh: 先用一张二维身体图、四个检查区域和两种异常实现完整循环。
firstStep.en: Use one 2D body diagram, four inspection regions and two conditions.

pitfall.zh: 第一版无需可旋转三维人体；关键是线索、位置和处理动作对应清楚。
pitfall.en: A rotating 3D body is unnecessary; match clues, locations and treatments clearly.

test.zh: 不给答案提示，看玩家能否通过检查找到并处理异常。
test.en: Without answer hints, see whether inspection leads to the correct treatment.
